paragraphs: R. Chiyya bar Abba, son of Bar Kappara's sister; his voice was pleasant. So too Yalkut, portion Reeh, passage 892, says “son of Bar Kappara's sister.” Yalkut on Proverbs, section 3, has “Chiyya, son of R. Eliezer HaKappar's sister,” whose voice was beautiful. See Bar Pada above, and R. Chiyya bar Adda immediately below.
